**bscan_worst.png**: The lowest-scoring held-out scan by mean Dice over the fluid types its expert outline contains, shown on its B-scan with the most expert-outlined fluid. The model marked no fluid on this B-scan, which was chosen as the slice with the most expert-marked fluid, so it shows a complete miss on that slice. Left, the expert's outline; right, the model's. Chosen by the rule pre-registered in `docs/07` §21, from the numbers alone, before any image was rendered.

**bscan_median.png**: The median held-out scan by mean Dice over the fluid types its expert outline contains, shown on its B-scan with the most expert-outlined fluid. Left, the expert's outline; right, the model's. Chosen by the rule pre-registered in `docs/07` §21, from the numbers alone, before any image was rendered.

**bscan_best.png**: The highest-scoring held-out scan by mean Dice over the fluid types its expert outline contains, shown on its B-scan with the most expert-outlined fluid. The ranking uses only the fluid types the expert marked; the model also predicted PED, which the expert did not mark, so even the best case shows the false-positive pattern. Left, the expert's outline; right, the model's. Chosen by the rule pre-registered in `docs/07` §21, from the numbers alone, before any image was rendered.

**bscan_fp_irf.png**: The largest false-positive case for IRF among the held-out scans: of the scans whose expert outline contains no IRF, the one in which the model marked the most IRF, shown on its B-scan with the most model-marked IRF. **This is the largest such case, not a typical one**; for typical sizes, see the predicted-voxel figure. Left, the expert's outline; right, the model's. Chosen by the rule pre-registered in `docs/07` §21, from the numbers alone, before any image was rendered.
